summary: Iteration 12: Biometric Unlock (WebAuthn passkeys) end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_webauthn.py (-n 0 serial: 0.42s). Frontend E2E via Playwright CDP virtual authenticator (ctap2/internal/hasResidentKey/hasUserVerification/isUserVerified/automaticPresenceSimulation on preview domain vault-login-6.preview.emergentagent.com) all critical checks green: (1) Pre-registration: GET /api/webauthn/status={enabled:false} → biometric-unlock-button HIDDEN on locked screen ✅ (2) PIN 1234 via keyboard unlocks vault, settings-button visible ✅ (3) Settings opens, 'Biometric Unlock' section with biometric-enable-button visible; subtitle exactly 'Is device pe enabled hai' present in ChangePinDialog.jsx line 120 ✅ (4) Click Enable → POST /webauthn/register/options 200 (rp.id=vault-login-6.preview.emergentagent.com, alg -8/-7/-257) → navigator.credentials.create on virtual authenticator (1 credential stored) → POST /webauthn/register/verify 200 {enabled:true} → button switches to biometric-disable-button with label 'Disable' ✅ (5) Lock vault → PIN screen shows biometric-unlock-button 'Unlock with fingerprint / face' (status enabled:true, count:1) ✅ (6) Click biometric-unlock-button → POST /webauthn/auth/options 200 (allowCredentials contains registered id, userVerification:required) → navigator.credentials.get on virtual authenticator → POST /webauthn/auth/verify 200 returns fresh JWT (ver:24) → vault unlocks WITHOUT PIN entry, settings-button + 11 tab elements render ✅ (7) Re-open Settings, click biometric-disable-button → DELETE /webauthn/credentials 200 {deleted:1} → biometric-enable-button reappears; GET status now {enabled:false,count:0} → biometric-unlock-button no longer served ✅ (8) Regression: PIN unlock still works, wrong-PIN shake exists in code, settings Change PIN section unchanged, auto-lock 2/5/10 min selector renders, Logins tab loads (PNB Net Banking existing seed intact). Cleanup: passkey deleted at end (backend has 0 credentials for vault_owner). No test entries created; existing user data (PNB) untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: PinScreen.jsx line 84-91: useEffect for keydown listener has NO dependency array, so it re-binds/unbinds on every render. Not a bug (cleanup runs correctly) but wasteful; add [busy, pin, isSetup, firstPin] or use a ref for latest state. Low severity.
webauthn.js b64urlToBytes uses atob without try/catch; malformed server response would throw a generic error. Consider validating before decoding. Low severity, server is trusted.
PinScreen bioUnlock swallows NotAllowedError/AbortError silently — good UX (user cancel), but no telemetry. Acceptable.

server.py RP ID derivation from x-forwarded-host header is correct for Cloudflare preview, but if a future deployment removes that header the fallback to host header could break existing passkeys (RP ID mismatch → user's passkey unusable). Consider a configurable RP_ID env var override for production robustness.
ChangePinDialog subtitle 'Is device pe enabled hai' is Hinglish; consistent with app's mixed-language UX (matches 'Auto-lock timing aur Master PIN yahan se manage karo'). No action needed.
biometric-disable-button label 'Disable' during in-flight request briefly shows '...'; no aria-live announcement. Minor a11y improvement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all specified WebAuthn E2E flows via CDP virtual authenticator

seed_data_creation: Registered 1 WebAuthn credential during E2E; deleted at end via DELETE /api/webauthn/credentials (backend count=0). No credentials/cards/insurance rows created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CDP virtual authenticator works fine in this environment. Enable it with client.send('WebAuthn.enable') + addVirtualAuthenticator options {protocol:'ctap2',transport:'internal',hasResidentKey:true,hasUserVerification:true,isUserVerified:true,automaticPresenceSimulation:true}. RP ID resolves to vault-login-6.preview.emergentagent.com via x-forwarded-host. Test IDs: biometric-enable-button, biometric-disable-button (in ChangePinDialog Settings), biometric-unlock-button (PinScreen when /webauthn/status.enabled=true). Post-lock, allow ~800ms for status fetch before asserting biometric button. When closing Settings dialog, click the [X] close button (data-testid may be absent — use aria-label or role='dialog' + first button) rather than Escape which sometimes doesn't dismiss due to focus; sequential ops between dialog transitions need 500-800ms waits. To disable via API: DELETE /api/webauthn/credentials with Authorization: Bearer <token>.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Full WebAuthn ceremony works: register/options → create → register/verify → status flips → auth/options → get → auth/verify → JWT returned → onUnlock. Origin verification against https://{x-forwarded-host} correctly handles Cloudflare Origin rewriting.
